project_produceos_description:
Multi-tenant SaaS platform for the end-to-end management of a fresh produce (fruit, vegetables and agricultural commodities) distribution and international trading business, built on Odoo ERP with its own modern web layer.

I collaborated on the development of a suite of functional modules:

- ERP core: sales and purchase orders, receipts, inventory and valuation, lots with traceability from farm to customer, invoices, credit notes, payments and accounts receivable.
- CRM & sales: deal pipeline, product catalog with parent/variant taxonomy (commodity, variety, grade, GTIN), promotions, supplier price lists and e-shop.
- Trade intelligence: sourcing, trading offers, market price analytics (USDA sources) and Clearance OS — customs clearance management module aligned to ACE/ABI/CATAIR standards and FDA/PGA requirements.
- Unified communications hub: a single inbox merging Gmail, Outlook, WhatsApp (Twilio/Unipile) and Slack with ERP documents, with two-way linking and push notifications.
- AI Copilot: conversational assistant over business data (OpenAI) with per-tenant permission guards.
- SaaS platform: onboarding with OTP verification (email/SMS), plans, entitlements, trials, Stripe billing and multi-company isolation.
- Architecture: defined the BFF pattern with a typed API contract and config-driven UI — new documents/lists/workflows are added through configuration without rewriting renderers; architecture documentation (FRAMEWORK.md, ARCHITECTURE.md) and 20+ technical specs.
- Quality: per-module unit test suite, lint/typecheck and a CI/CD pipeline with automated deployment per branch.
project_sapiens_description:
Academic and scientific social network (collaborative project, under development) connecting students, teachers and researchers to share articles, research documents and institutional announcements, organized by category and institution. I took part in its development with the team, from the backend to the frontend integration.

Key features:

- End-to-end registration and authentication: multi-step form (email → verification code → password → terms), JWT sessions in httpOnly cookies, password reset and change, user invitations and resumable registration without persisting intermediate data.
- Content publishing: articles and documents with title, description, content, categories, institution, links and attachments.
- Social interaction: likes/dislikes, saving, threaded replies, follow/unfollow and follower/following lists.
- Personalized feeds: home, following, saved, liked, profile tabs and public wall.
- Cursor-based pagination with infinite scroll: API contracts with nextCursor/hasMore and IntersectionObserver integration on the frontend, with composite indexes on both databases for efficient queries at large volume.
- Editable profiles, notification center, settings panel (system, account, light/dark theme) and chat plus swipe-style discovery modules.

Collaboratively I built, among other tasks, the rewritten registration flow as a stateless architecture with signed cookies, cursor pagination on the posts/users/replies APIs with infinite-scroll integration, institutional data loading and UX improvements for default images.

Under continuous development: some modules (chat, swipe, notifications) are still in a demo state and several routes are not enabled yet.
